_61.TextB:
A must-have for quick level-ups.
> Exp +100%
> Reduces damage to the tamer's health
> DS recovery +100%
> This is a time-restricted item.
> Right-click in your inventory to use this time. The effect and the time limit take effect immediately.
> During the effective period of the item, the time continues to flow even when you are logged out.
> An item cannot be used while another item of the same type is already in effect. 
------------------------------------------------
Purchase items can be found at @<tc:990>[Cash Warehouse]@</tc>

_251.TextB:
If you purchase and use consignment shop items, you can separately open a shop that is run on your behalf by a digimon.
 @<tc:990>Directions@</tc>
 1. Cash items purchased at the item shop moves to the cash storage within the game.
 2. Open the cash storage in the game and move the item to your inventory (right click).
 3. Use the item that has been moved to your inventory.
 @<tc:090>- When sales are complete after opening a consignment shop, the store is terminated and the items sold and the amount of sales are automatically saved at the shop icon at the bottom of the page --> consignment shop storage box.
 - Consignment shops are automatically shut down when the period expires, and items and amount sold are automatically saved in the consignment shop storage box.
 - Two or more consignment shop cannot be opened simultaneously.@</tc> 
------------------------------------------------
Purchase items can be found at @<tc:990>[Cash Warehouse]@</tc>

 @<tc:990>Directions@</tc>
